model_annotation: Figure 1 presents a circular diagram illustrating the relative shares of public funds, institutions, and economically active enterprises (FEU) of municipalities and municipal associations in Germany by task area for the years 2014 (inner ring) and 2021 (outer ring). The diagram is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with its corresponding task area and percentage share for both years. The inner ring segments, representing 2014, are colored in shades of blue, green, and purple, while the outer ring segments for 2021 use a wider range of colors including red, orange, and gray to differentiate the categories. The task areas and their approximate shares are: “Überge” (38.1% in 2014, 31.1% in 2021), “Kliniken” (3.2% in 2014, 4.7% in 2021), “Wirtschaftsförderung” (3.7% in 2014, 4.7% in 2021), “Verkehr” (1.5% in 2014, 1.3% in 2021), “Ernährung” (1.3% in 2014, 1.3% in 2021), “Kombinierte Versorgung” (1.3% in 2014, 1.5% in 2021), “Wasserversorgung” (1.5% in 2014, 6.9% in 2021), “Stromversorgung” (4.0% in 2014, 6.3% in 2021), “Abwasserentsorgung” (3.4% in 2014, 7.2% in 2021), and “Sport/Erholung” (2.4% in 2014, 4.1% in 2021). The diagram includes a legend that associates each segment with its respective task area, and the percentages are printed directly within each segment. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segments positioned at the top and decreasing in size as they move clockwise, though no explicit sorting order is indicated in the visual layout.
